requiredDataCorrections.beforeValue: Editorial/reuse decision pending.
requiredDataCorrections.afterValue: Retain single ambitransitive sense-run-machine; update /entity/definition to 'Function or operate, especially of a machine or system, or cause a machine, system, or program to function.'; clean workflow meta-language in usageNote, construction-run-machine-transitive/constraints/0, equiv-run-machine-operate/restrictions/0, and equiv-run-machine-operate-alternative/restrictions/0..1.
requiredDataCorrections.rationale: Re-evaluated under docs/sense-division.md ('A grammatical-frame change or a new preposition alone is not sufficient to split') and docs/ontology-v1.md §1.2 ('Construction owns syntax and valency'). Intransitive machine functioning ('The engine runs quietly') and transitive machine/program operation ('run a machine/program') form a productive causative/inchoative (ergative) alternation sharing the same core operational state, truth conditions (X runs Y entails Y runs), and selectional domain (machine/system). Both OALD (run_1 sense 7 [I, T]) and Cambridge (run OPERATE [I or T]) keep both frames in a single sense. Therefore, Option 2 (Retain single ambitransitive sense 'sense-run-machine' with its two attached Construction records and two contextual TranslationEquivalence records) is superior to splitting. However, Phase 9 COR-003 updated grammar.transitivity to 'ambitransitive' without broadening sense-run-machine's definition ('Function or operate, especially of a machine or system.'), which currently covers only the intransitive frame. Broadening /entity/definition and purging workflow meta-language from usageNote, con.constraints, and eqv.restrictions resolves the issue without a sense split.
evidence: SRC-OALD: run_1 verb sense 7 ([I, T] of a machine: to operate or function; to make a machine do this)
SRC-HOANG-PHE: hoạt động (intransitive) vs vận hành (transitive/technical)
counterEvidence: Current sense-run-machine /entity/definition states only 'Function or operate, especially of a machine or system.', omitting the causative transitive reading.

requiredDataCorrections.beforeValue: Editorial/reuse decision pending.
requiredDataCorrections.afterValue: Keep family-analysis /entity/familyBasis='editorially_related' (and entry-analyse/analysis/analytical /entity/familyIds=['candidate:family-analysis']); change family-analysis /entity/label to 'analyse / analysis / analytical word family'; attach OALD/Cambridge/OEWN evidence references.
requiredDataCorrections.rationale: Re-evaluated strictly against schemas/v2/word-family.schema.json (which permits only _id, schemaVersion, lifecycleStatus, editorialStatus, evidenceIds, revision, createdAt, updatedAt, retirement fields, familyBasis, and label; additionalProperties=false) and docs/ontology-v1.md §1.8 & §5 (membership is owned solely by LexicalEntry.familyIds[]; WordFamily has no rootLemma or memberEntryIds). Retaining familyBasis='editorially_related' on family-analysis is valid, conservative, and schema-compliant because it groups the synchronic cluster (analyse, analysis, analytical) without asserting a directed DERIVED_FROM edge (diachronically, analytical [1520s] and analysis [1580s] preceded analyse [c.1600]). Two corrections are required: (1) replace the invalid internal-only SRC-REPO evidence citation from Phase 8/9 with external lexicographic attestations (OALD, Cambridge, OEWN), and (2) remove the internal workflow word 'candidate' from family-analysis /entity/label ('analyse / analysis / analytical candidate family' -> 'analyse / analysis / analytical word family').
counterEvidence: family-analysis /entity/label currently contains internal workflow meta-language ('candidate family'), and Phase 8/9 cited only internal SRC-REPO.

optionalImprovements.rationale: Under schemas/v2/word-family.schema.json and docs/ontology-v1.md §5, 'editorially_related' is a valid, conservative familyBasis value for an undirected lexical cluster where no directed DERIVED_FROM relation is asserted. External lexicographic sources (OALD, Cambridge, OEWN) corroborate grouping analyse (v.), analysis (n.), and analytical (adj.) as a synchronic word family, resolving the Phase 8/9 evidence gap (where only internal SRC-REPO was cited). Upgrading to 'synchronically_derivational' is an optional improvement, not a required fix.

technicalFindings.topic: UUIDv7 mapping and evidence value digests
technicalFindings.rootCause: In pipeline/prepare-batch.mjs, resolveRefs() replaces 'candidate:<id>' strings with preview or minted '<prefix>_<uuidv7>' IDs, mutating the stored value of reference fields (/entryId, /senseId, /sourceSenseId, /targetSenseId, /sourceId, /targetId, /familyIds). However, prepareBatch() does not recompute Evidence.claim.valueDigest (a 64-char SHA-256 hex digest) if an 'evd_' candidate asserts a claim on one of those reference fields, causing validate-dataset-v2.mjs line 38 ('digest(valueAt(target, r.claim.fieldPath)) !== r.claim.valueDigest') to fail with EVIDENCE_CLAIM_MISMATCH.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: When binding or preparing 'evd_' records for reference claim paths (/entryId, /senseId, /sourceSenseId, /targetSenseId, /sourceId, /targetId, /familyIds), compute 'claim.valueDigest' against the resolved canonical ID (or recompute 'ev.claim.valueDigest = digest(valueAt(target, ev.claim.fieldPath))' inside prepareBatch after resolveRefs). Add a unit test verifying that a candidate batch containing an 'evd_' record on '/entryId' passes prepareBatch() and validateDatasetV2().

technicalFindings.topic: Candidate evidence binding workflow across prepareBatch and reviseCandidates
technicalFindings.rootCause: All 54 candidate records in pilot-fanout-002.json currently have 'evidenceIds: []' and 0 'src_' / 'evd_' records inside the batch. Meanwhile, pipeline/revise-candidates.mjs line 5 explicitly places 'evidenceIds' in the immutable 'forbidden' set ('REVISION_FIELD_FORBIDDEN') and runs validateDatasetV2() after every draft revision (which fails with EVIDENCE_CLAIM_MISMATCH if a revised field already had an 'evd_' digest bound to its old value).
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: In Phase 12, apply all text revisions to produce the updated candidate snapshot (or revise draft text first) BEFORE generating and binding the 372 exact-value 'evd_' records and their 'evidenceIds' arrays, or provide a dedicated evidence-binding step in the pipeline that atomically updates a draft record's field, 'evidenceIds', and matching 'evd_.claim.valueDigest'.

technicalFindings.rootCause: While Evidence.claim binds 'valueDigest' (SHA-256 of the exact field value) and phase10-editorial-review-queue.json records 'valueDigest' per review item, V2 EditorialReview.claims[] only stores '{ subjectId, fieldPath }' without 'valueDigest' or 'subjectRevision'. In production-gates.mjs lines 131-135, a review item is matched to a field solely by 'evidence.some(ev => ev.claim.fieldPath === item.fieldPath)'. If a record's field is modified AND a new 'evd_' record is attached for the new value, a pre-existing 'rev_' record for '{ subjectId, fieldPath }' would remain active unless retired or bound to 'valueDigest'.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Ensure Phase 12 review binding verifies that any accepted review decision matches the current 'valueDigest' of 'valueAt(subject, fieldPath)' (consistent with tests/production/phase10-editorial-review.test.mjs: 'Modified/new claims do not inherit approval'). Optionally allow optional 'valueDigest' on EditorialReview.claims[] in V2.

technicalFindings.topic: Reviewer authority and AI-only publication boundary
technicalFindings.rootCause: By design, evaluatePublication() and promoteCandidates() require externally injected, authenticated callbacks ('verifyOwnerAttestation', 'verifyEvidence', 'verifyRights'), 'ownerId', 'effectiveAt', and scoped 'appointments'. Self-reported JSON strings can never convey publication authority, and AI research completion ('PHASE_11_AI_RESEARCH_COMPLETE') is strictly separated from publication eligibility ('PUBLICATION_READY').
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Preserve fail-closed behavior in stock CLI. Any Phase 12–13 transition to an owner-authorized AI-only publication gate must be explicitly authorized by the Owner/Lead Architect via authenticated external callbacks rather than weakening authority-v2.mjs.

technicalFindings.topic: Symmetric lexical relation canonicalization in prepareBatch
technicalFindings.rootCause: validators/graph-v1.mjs line 165 enforces that every symmetric LexicalRelation ('SYNONYM_OF', 'NEAR_SYNONYM_OF', 'ANTONYM_OF') must have 'compareStrings(record.sourceId, record.targetId) < 0' ('RELATION_NOT_CANONICAL'). However, pipeline/prepare-batch.mjs lines 113-115 resolves 'sourceId: "candidate:..."' and 'targetId: "candidate:..."' into SHA-256 preview IDs (dryRun) or UUIDv7 strings without sorting '[sourceId, targetId]' into ascending ASCII order afterward. Whenever 'resolvedSourceId > resolvedTargetId' (which occurs deterministically on 'rel-big-small-antonym' in dryRun and randomly whenever two UUIDv7s share the same millisecond timestamp), prepareBatch() fails with VALIDATION_FAILED (RELATION_NOT_CANONICAL).
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: In pipeline/prepare-batch.mjs, immediately after 'resolveRefs(item.entity, mapping)', if the record prefix is 'rel' and 'relationType' is symmetric ('SYNONYM_OF', 'NEAR_SYNONYM_OF', 'ANTONYM_OF') with 'sourceId > targetId', swap 'sourceId' and 'targetId'. Add a regression test preparing 'rel-big-large-near-synonym', 'rel-big-small-antonym', and 'rel-large-small-antonym' in both dryRun and live modes.

technicalFindings.topic: Translation review gates for gloss_only vs sense_aligned
technicalFindings.rootCause: In validators/production-gates.mjs lines 148-154, both the endpoint verification check ('BILINGUAL_ENDPOINT_UNVERIFIED') and the translation review check ('if (record.translationEvidenceStatus !== "independently_reviewed") add("TRANSLATION_UNREVIEWED", ...)') are nested inside 'if (record._id.startsWith("eqv_") && record.alignmentMode === "sense_aligned")'. As a result, all 16 'gloss_only' TranslationEquivalence records completely bypass 'TRANSLATION_UNREVIEWED' (and source-sense 'editorialStatus === "verified"' verification) during evaluatePublication()!
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: In validators/production-gates.mjs, check 'record.translationEvidenceStatus !== "independently_reviewed"' ('TRANSLATION_UNREVIEWED') and verify that 'byId.get(record.sourceSenseId)?.editorialStatus === "verified"' for ALL 'eqv_' records ('gloss_only' and 'sense_aligned' alike), while checking 'targetSenseId' verification when 'alignmentMode === "sense_aligned"'. Add a unit test verifying that a 'gloss_only' record with 'translationEvidenceStatus: "unreviewed"' is blocked by 'TRANSLATION_UNREVIEWED'.

technicalFindings.rootCause: When 'options.subjectIds' is passed to evaluatePublication(), lines 76-85 compute the dependency closure by traversing outbound references on the selected records: for 'sns_', it pushes 'r.entryId', '...(r.topicIds ?? [])', and '...(r.constructionIds ?? [])'. Because 'sense.constructionIds' is optional and empty ('[]') across all 15 senses in pilot-fanout-002.json (where constructions link via 'con.senseId'), scoping publication to a 'sns_' ID omits its attached 'con_' records from the closure unless the caller explicitly includes the 'con_' IDs in 'subjectIds'.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Either include inbound 'con_' records ('con.senseId === r._id') in the dependency closure when 'r._id' is a 'sns_' (or document and enforce that scoped promotion of a sense requires explicit inclusion or population of 'sense.constructionIds').

technicalFindings.topic: Single source of truth Construction.senseId vs LexicalSense.constructionIds
technicalFindings.rootCause: In V1/V2, 'Construction.senseId' is the required canonical foreign key linking a construction to its sense, while 'LexicalSense.constructionIds' is an optional denormalized array checked for consistency ('CONSTRUCTION_SENSE_MISMATCH') when present. In pilot-fanout-002.json, all 15 senses set 'constructionIds: []' and rely on 'con.senseId' as the single source of truth.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Keep 'Construction.senseId' as the single required source of truth; do not require redundant manual maintenance of 'sense.constructionIds', and align TF-07 closure traversal with 'con.senseId'.

technicalFindings.topic: Graph integrity when splitting or merging senses
technicalFindings.rootCause: graph-v1.mjs and lifecycle-v2.mjs deterministically enforce 'RETIRED_LIVE_REFERENCE', 'DECISION_TRANSITION_MISMATCH', 'MERGE_GROUP_INVALID', 'UNREVIEWED_SPLIT_FANOUT', and 'LIFECYCLE_AUDIT_INCOMPLETE', preventing automatic fan-out of inbound edges ('eqv_', 'rel_', 'con_', 'col_') across split senses without explicit reviewed reattachment.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Verified by existing tests in tests/graph-integrity.test.mjs, tests/production/lifecycle-v2.test.mjs, and tests/production/lifecycle-adjudication.test.mjs. No change needed.

technicalFindings.rootCause: evaluatePublication() and promoteCandidates() fail-closed whenever any claim lacks exact-value digest-matched independent evidence, cleared source redistribution rights, or authenticated reviewer/LER callbacks.
technicalFindings.phase12SpecificationAndAcceptanceTest: Verified by tests/production/publication.test.mjs, tests/production/promotion.test.mjs, and tests/production/authority.test.mjs. Must remain fail-closed in Phase 12–13.
